subject: Add XXH3_initCustomSecret_rvv func
perf_evidence: Adds an RVV-vectorized XXH3_initCustomSecret (previously scalar on RVV) and moves accumulate/scramble from LMUL=1 to LMUL=2 vectors (vuint64m2_t, vsetvl_e64m2) to process more lanes per instruction; bench Makefile updated. SIMD speed-up intent.
change_summary: accumulate_512_rvv and scrambleAcc_rvv switched from m1 to m2 register groups (swap/prime arrays widened to 16); new XXH3_initCustomSecret_rvv (strip-mined vadd of kSecret with {seed,-seed,...}); XXH_SEC_ALIGN=64 for RVV.

units.name: XXH3_accumulate_512_rvv (m1 -> m2)
units.evidence: Alive2: 'ERROR: Unsupported type: <vscale x 1 x i64>' / 'Unsupported instruction: tail call <vscale x 1 x i64> @llvm.riscv.vle.nxv1i64.i64(...)' -> 'Could not translate' (old) / <vscale x 2 x i64> (new)

units.name: XXH3_scrambleAcc_rvv (m1 -> m2)
units.evidence: Alive2: 'ERROR: Unsupported type: <vscale x 1 x i64>' / 'Unsupported instruction: tail call <vscale x 1 x i64> @llvm.riscv.vle.nxv1i64.i64(...)' -> 'Could not translate' (old) / <vscale x 2 x i64> (new)

units.name: XXH3_initCustomSecret (scalar -> rvv)
units.evidence: Alive2: 'ERROR: Unsupported type: <vscale x 2 x i64>' / 'Unsupported instruction: call <vscale x 2 x i64> @llvm.riscv.vle.nxv2i64.i64(...)' -> 'Could not translate' in target_initsecret (new side)

units.name: XXH3_64bits_withSeed(p,1024,seed) on riscv64 rv64gcv
units.evidence: Alive2 cannot translate scalable-vector RVV intrinsics on either side (target_api_len1024)

notes: x86-64 IR unchanged: wrapper with all one-shot APIs (XXH32/XXH64/XXH3_64 seed+secret/XXH3_128, symbolic len) compiled with -march=x86-64-v3 and with default SSE2 gives identical modules except !srcloc line metadata (x86_ident_v3/, x86_ident_sse2/); riscv64 -march=rv64gc (no V) also identical target IR (ident_rv64gc_novector/). RVV intrinsics compile to scalable-vector LLVM types (<vscale x N x i64>) and llvm.riscv.* calls, which Alive2 cannot translate at all; even with -march=rv64gcv_zvl512b -mrvv-vector-bits=zvl the IR keeps scalable types (vscale_range(8,8)), see 2973489/compile_rvv_zvl512/. Inputs are value args (U8ARGS) copied into local arrays; XXH3_accumulate_512/XXH3_scrambleAcc/XXH3_initCustomSecret are the library's own dispatch macros. Flags: --target riscv64-linux-gnu, cflags '-O3 -fno-strict-aliasing -fno-vectorize -fno-slp-vectorize -w -nostdlibinc -isystem _work2020/cross_sysinc -march=rv64gcv' + '-DXXH_NO_INLINE_HINTS=1 -mllvm -inline-threshold=100000' (no -ffreestanding so memcpy stays a builtin). No part of the changed code could be checked.
